discordance.assumption: Independent match pairs; descriptive reference only under tennis dependence

diagnostics.interpretation: Descriptive concentration and overconfidence counts; no event or observation is removed using these diagnostics.

subgroups.status: Exploratory, no subgroup hypothesis tests or selection

clustering.event: Exact tourney_id edition, including year and all draws; any date/year span stays in the same recorded event ID
clustering.calendar_28d: Non-overlapping fixed 28-day bins since Monday 1970-01-05; group whole events by earliest full-test reference date, retain anchor for all subsets
clustering.limitations: Resampling units are assumed independent within each design, not empirically proven independent. Repeated players across events/blocks and longer dependence remain. Tournament reference dates are not exact match dates. No bootstrap resolves unidentified V1 row order or source availability.

inferential_limits: Pointwise percentile intervals, no family-wise coverage claim. All subset/ancillary/scoring analyses exploratory. McNemar is an iid-match reference. No DeLong iid p-value, equivalence test, or practical superiority claim. Uncertainty conditions on fixed fitted models and frozen predictions; excludes training/model-selection uncertainty.
